DREAM SCHOOL ROUND 3 — THE MOMENT (2 minutes)
This is the crescendo of the entire seminar. EVERYTHING has built to this moment.
STEP 1: Copy the description from Claude. STEP 2: Click the Bing Image Creator tab. Paste into the prompt field. STEP 3: Hit Generate.
STEP 4 — CRUCIAL: While it generates (usually 10-15 seconds), go SILENT. Step back from the laptop. Look at the class. Let the suspense build.
STEP 5: Image appears.
DO NOT SAY ANYTHING FOR 5 FULL SECONDS.
Let them look. Let them react. Let the room fill with their response.
THEN say, softly: "This is your school. You built this."
Wait another 2 seconds.
"Not any one of you. ALL of you. Every idea on that screen came from someone sitting in this room. AI didn't dream this up. AI drew what YOU imagined."
PHOTO MOMENT: Ask everyone to stand, look at the screen, and take a moment. If a teacher has a phone, take a group photo of the room with the image on screen. This is the seminar's memory artifact.
Print this image if possible. Put it on the school notice board. It becomes a permanent reminder of what these students created.
